known_limitations: All results to date are gemma-3-1b-it on CPU, N<=4 seeds. Nothing here is powered.
Affect baseline sd falls back to 1.0 (healthy text has zero affect hits), so the affect CUSUM z-scale is NOMINAL not estimated.
Only 6 of 33 affect stems are traceable to published differential vocabulary; 27 are ours. Sensitivity analysis over the split is REQUIRED before any ordering claim.
Semantic-recurrence signal is specified and implemented but NOT yet run (needs banked hidden states).
Judges are specified but NOT yet run; no reliability numbers exist.
kv_prune 'sparse' dose rung was REMOVED as unimplementable via crop(); do not expect it.
changelog: v2.0: RETRACTS all pre-EOS-fix results. Adds TRAP_post_eos_contamination.md (generation ran past <end_of_turn>; the lexical criterion scored delimiter spam as a perfect loop, giving a spurious 79% loop rate) and ENDPOINTS.md (loop_flag PRIMARY / lexical_onset / soft_loop_band; '3/140' = loop_flag). New clean data: clean_A2A5, clean_A1, rescue_grid. claims.py now sources ONLY clean files, and generates endpoint_hierarchy + headline_stats (Fisher, raw AND length-controlled Mann-Whitney, per-arm Fisher). 21 claims, all resolved.

v1.5: (a) THRESHOLD RULE CHANGE, prereg-critical. The loop criterion is now a PERCENTILE RULE resolved per model (thresholds.py): rep-4 > healthy p99.9 OR distinct-2 < healthy p0.1 of the SAME model/revision. Absolute numbers are unsafe -- gpt2's p99.9 (0.0619) equals gemma-3-1b's p95, so freezing it would run gemma at ~5% false positives instead of 0.1%. Resolved for gemma-3-1b-it: rep4>0.1405, d2<0.7209. NOTE the d2 arm moved a long way: the previously-used 0.20 sits BELOW gemma's p0.1, i.e. it was far stricter than intended and contributed almost nothing beyond the rep-4 arm. (b) run_powered.py now takes --calib and refuses to run without it, records threshold_rule provenance, and BANKS PER-TOKEN SERIES so episodes can be rescored under a changed criterion without regenerating. (c) Added run_matrix.yaml + interventions.yaml, GENERATED from live modules by export_specs.py -- both cross-checked to agree with thresholds.resolve(). (d) Added the minimal-viable rescue grid (run_rescue.py + interventions.apply_arm): 3 drug classes x 2 doses + null/sham comparators, trichotomous outcome, run on banked episodes.

v1.4: added claims.py -- every reportable number is READ FROM ITS ARTIFACT with the source file and key path recorded, after two findings traced to hardcoded figures. It disambiguates the case that caused one: gemma healthy rep-4 p99.9 = 0.1405 (calib_gemma3_1b_it.json) vs the SUPERSEDED gpt2 p99.9 = 0.0619 (threshold_calibration.json) -- which equals gemma's p95 exactly, hence the confusion. Added run_powered.py (matched-pair ordering at N, with cached external baselines so chunks stay poolable, and representational recurrence computed via one teacher-forced pass) and analyse_powered.py (bootstrap CIs, MIN_PAIRS_CI=3 guard against degenerate k=1 intervals). Corrected affect_lexicon.yaml usable_here: it listed 9 published-traceable stems but stems_published contains 6; loss/myself/deeply are excluded BY OUR CHOICE and that is now stated as such.

v1.3: CORRECTION to the v1.1 changelog claim. The v1.1 fix reached only the module-level docstring in ordering.py; calibrate_cusum()'s own docstring still shipped 'k=0.5,h=30 reached 7.5 tokens vs 9.0 for the selected k=1.0,h=5.0' (wrong on both figures: the lowest-lag passing row is k=0.5,h=16 at 7.5, and the selected row's median lag error is 12.0, not 9.0), and SEMANTIC_RECURRENCE_SPEC.md still shipped the pre-correction fa=0.033 / 9-token figures. Both are now corrected and every quoted figure was asserted against live calibrate_cusum() output (selected k=1.0,h=5: fa=0.0267, median lag err 12.0, zero-lag err 11.0; lowest-lag passing row k=0.5,h=16 at 7.5). v1.1 and v1.2 of this packet carry the wrong figures in those two files.

v1.2: added PRIOR_ART_2512.12895.md (Pipis et al., 'Why Do Reasoning Models Loop?') — mechanism paper, not a novelty threat; settles the temperature-arm ceiling (temperature is a published stopgap, not a fix) and confirms dropping the Qwen3 thinking arm (loop-proneness tracks distillation+scale, not thinking mode; R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B at 0.76 is the loop-prone model class). Added harness.loops_nk()/max_ngram_repeat() implementing their (n=30,k=20) criterion as a published comparator, plus criterion_comparison.csv: (30,20) fires on exactly our 4 sustained hard loops (rep-4 0.691-1.000) and misses 3 soft loops (rep-4 up to 0.660), so the soft-loop phenotype is not a lax-threshold artifact.
v1.1: verified the arXiv:2309.17453 attention-sink figures against the paper's own HTML (Table 2: Llama-2-13B PG-19 ppl 5158.07 window-only vs 5.40 with 4 sink tokens) and added the exact locator.

v1.1: calibrate_cusum() defaults now reproduce the CUSUM_K/CUSUM_H selection exactly (CALIB_CASES/CALIB_HS module constants); selection rule stated; corrected docstring figures to the reproducible values (fa=0.027, median lag err 12 tokens).
